text: {"assertions":["A silent drop bug in notifications/push/dispatch.py was identified and fixed on 2026-01-15, where sends reported success but had no delivery.","The silent drop issue only occurred for records carrying non-ASCII names.","The root cause was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) in the notifications system.","The fix was implemented in PR #1497 on branch fix/silent-drop-1 by adding the composite index and backfilling data in batches.","The silent drop could be reproduced by dispatching to a device token that was rotated.","The fix was validated when nightly rollup metrics matched source counts for 71 consecutive days."]}
